title: Morning Will Come
style: contemporary gospel ballad, inspirational soul, warm grand piano, Hammond organ swells, lush strings, mature soulful female vocal, rich gospel choir, 68 bpm, tender, hopeful, slow-burning triumphant build
negativeTags: trap, EDM, rock, distorted, rap, country
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Soft piano, distant organ)

[Verse 1]
There's a chair beside the window
Where the light used to fall
And the house has learned the quiet
Of a name I still call

[Pre-Chorus]
I don't understand the reason
But I trust the One who knows

[Chorus]
Morning will come
After the longest night
Morning will come
And bring me back to light
Though I weep through the dark, I will lift up my song
Morning will come

[Verse 2]
I have heard the old folks testify
Of the joy that waits ahead
How the Lord can turn a valley
Into a table spread

[Pre-Chorus]
I don't have to see tomorrow
Just to know that He'll be there

[Chorus]
Morning will come
After the longest night
Morning will come
And bring me back to light
Though I weep through the dark, I will lift up my song
Morning will come

[Bridge]
(Choir enters, building)
Joy comes in the morning, joy comes in the morning
Weeping may endure, but joy comes in the morning
(Lead ad-libs over choir)

[Final Chorus]
(Key change, full choir)
Morning will come
After the longest night
Morning will come
And bring me back to light
Though I weep through the dark, I will lift up my song
Morning will come

[Outro]
(Piano and soft choir)
Morning will come
